verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਸਿਹਿਜਾਸਨ ਜਉ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਜਾਮਨੀ ਸਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਸੁਜਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaat sihijaasan jau kaamanee jaamanee samai gur jan sujan kee baat na suhaat hai ||

en.bdb: When a wife proceeds to enjoy the union of her husband in his bed at night, no talk of any noble, elderly or holy person appeals to her.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਿਮਕਰ ਉਦਿਤ ਮੁਦਤਿ ਹੈ ਚਕੋਰ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕ ਟਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ਸਮਾਰਤ ਨ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: himakar udhit mudhat hai chakor chit ik Tak dhiaan kai samaarat na gaat hai ||

en.bdb: As the moon rises, the ruddy sheldrake is immensely pleased and gazing at it with concentration of mind, is unaware of his own body even.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise madhukar makara(n)dh ras lubhit hai bisam kamal dhal sa(n)paT samaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a bumble bee is so engrossed in the sweet smelling nectar of the flower, that it gets trapped in the box-like lotus flower when the Sun sets.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਿਖ ਦਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਮੁਸਕਾਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੩੩॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur charan saran chal jaat sikh dharas paras prem ras musakaat hai ||433||

en.bdb: Similarly a devoted slave disciple goes to the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru; enjoying His sight and entranced in His love, he keeps smiling within while relishing the divine spectacle.  (433)
